dedupe_keys.name: consejo de monumentos nacionales chile national monuments register statistics and polygons

description: Consejo de Monumentos Nacionales de Chile (National Monuments Council) publishes downloadable files on Chile's declared National Monuments: a register of each monument officially decreed by the Council (which omits archaeological and public monuments), regional and national statistics of monuments declared by decree (excluding those withdrawn), and official monument polygons and points as KMZ files for Google Earth, all updated to February 2026 according to the page. Coverage: the whole of Chile; the files were updated to February 2026 and the page was read on 2026-09-29. Format and access: two XLSX workbooks and two KMZ files, downloadable without registration from the Council's indicators page, which is in Spanish; a separate Geoportal and thematic viewers are listed on the portals page. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-29); cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the register columns, the number of monuments and the positional accuracy of the polygons are unconfirmed; archaeological and public monuments are omitted from the register; no licence statement was found. Simulation uses: heritage-asset exposure layers for seismic, tsunami, flood and wildfire risk studies of historic buildings and districts, and a register to join with building-stock and tourism-infrastructure models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
